name: ES Mean Reversion — RSI + Bollinger Bands (RTH, 1H)
description: Mean reversion strategy on ES S&P 500 E-mini futures using 1-hour RTH bars. Long entry: RSI(14) < 30 AND close <= lower Bollinger Band(20, 2.0). Short entry: RSI(14) > 70 AND close >= upper Bollinger Band(20, 2.0). Exits: RSI crosses 50, close crosses BB midband, 1.5×ATR(14) hard stop, or forced flat at 16:00 ET session close. Fixed 1 contract sizing. Front-month roll 5 days before expiry with backward ratio adjustment.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES Mean Reversion: RSI + Bollinger Bands, RTH Only, 1-Hour Bars
# =============================================================================
# Long:  RSI(14) < 30 AND close <= lower BB(20, 2.0)
# Short: RSI(14) > 70 AND close >= upper BB(20, 2.0)
# Exits: RSI cross 50, close cross BB mid, 1.5×ATR stop, EOD flat
# Sizing: 1 contract fixed. Roll: 5 days before expiry, backward ratio adj.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ES continuous front-month futures ---
src = study_assets(target_timeframe=["1H"])()

cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LastTradingDay,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio,
    i_offset=5
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- RTH Session Filter: 09:30–16:00 ET ---
rth = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:30', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York')
)(cont.o, cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, cont.v)

is_rth = rth.active
is_eod = rth.closed

# --- Indicators (computed on continuation prices) ---
close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l

rsi_val = rsi(close, 14)
upper_bb, mid_bb, lower_bb = bbands(close, period=20, stddev=2.0)
atr_val = atr(high, low, close, 14)

# --- Entry Signals (RTH only) ---
long_entry_raw = rsi_val < 30 and close <= lower_bb and is_rth
short_entry_raw = rsi_val > 70 and close >= upper_bb and is_rth

# --- Exit Signals ---
# 1. RSI crosses above 50 (exit long) / crosses below 50 (exit short)
rsi_cross_up_50 = crossover(rsi_val, 50)
rsi_cross_dn_50 = crossunder(rsi_val, 50)

# 2. Close crosses above BB midband (exit long) / crosses below BB midband (exit short)
close_cross_up_mid = crossover(close, mid_bb)
close_cross_dn_mid = crossunder(close, mid_bb)

# 3. EOD forced flat (session close at 16:00 ET)
# 4. Hard stop handled by stop_loss executor

# --- Combine exit conditions per direction ---
long_exit = rsi_cross_up_50 or close_cross_up_mid or is_eod
short_exit = rsi_cross_dn_50 or close_cross_dn_mid or is_eod

# --- State Management ---
# hold_until: persist entry until exit fires
# Entry signals are rare (RSI<30 + below lower BB), so hold_until is needed
# to maintain position across bars until exit triggers
long_held = hold_until(long_entry_raw, long_exit)
short_held = hold_until(short_entry_raw, short_exit)

# --- Execution Wiring (E16 order) ---
# 1. Rollover policy (futures required)
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# 2. Signal executor — wire long exit as short_entry to flatten, and vice versa
#    Using held states gated to RTH
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_held, short_entry=short_held)

# 3. Position sizing: fixed 1 contract
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=1)

# 4. Hard stop: 1.5 × ATR(14) from entry
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=atr_val * 1.5)
